walkthroughs.body_html:
Sir James Dyson made over 5,000 prototypes before his bagless vacuum worked.

His big idea: vacuum bags clogged up. He invented a cyclone that spun dust out. 🌀

Lesson: innovation and resilience matter. Most ideas only work after lots of failures.

Sir Richard Branson started a student magazine at 16, then a record shop called Virgin.

Today Virgin owns trains, airlines, gyms and more.

Branson's secret: a bold vision and great customer focus. He treats staff well, and they treat customers well. ✈️

Look at successful founders and you spot the same traits:

  • They spot a problem others ignore.
  • They take risks but plan carefully.
  • They listen to customers and improve.
  • They don't give up when things go wrong.

You can practise these traits at any age. 💪

options: Limited liability means a business can only operate for a limited time.

Workers are motivated by social factors and the feeling of being noticed/valued — not just pay or physical conditions. Productivity rose because researchers paid attention to workers, not because lighting improved.
Mayo proved that better lighting increases productivity.
